name: Ananias
bio: Ananias, with his wife Sapphira, sold a possession but secretly kept back part of the proceeds while claiming to give the whole amount to the apostles. Peter confronted him for lying to the Holy Spirit rather than merely to men; upon hearing this, Ananias fell down dead, and great fear came upon all who heard of it (Acts 5:1-6, 11). He is a different figure from the Ananias who later restored Paul's sight and the high priest Ananias who presided over Paul's trial.
